s: Furthermore, laws relating to privacy and data protection, including with respect to the use of data in artificial intelligence and machine learning, are rapidly evolving, extensive, complex and include inconsistencies and uncertainties.

The enactment of such laws could have potentially conflicting requirements that would make compliance challenging. • The United States government is considering regulating artificial intelligence and machine learning. -39- • The certifications we maintain and the standards we comply with, including the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard, among others, are becoming more stringent.
